text:
Aisha - CSM: Morning team, posting this week's check-in for Galen Labs (private VPC). TL;DR: usage +2% week-over-week, spend trending +18% last 7d due to retry storms, eu-west region latency spike (p95 ~320ms up from 120ms), and ap-south KMS 5xx bursts last 24h. Renewal touchpoint next month — customer is concerned about predictability. Sharing details below.

Liam - Solutions Eng: Can you paste a couple sample request IDs or log snippets for the KMS 5xxs? I want to check client retry windows and SDK behavior.

Aisha - CSM: Pasting a sanitized logfile excerpt from their agent (timestamps UTC):
```
2026-03-18T02:13:12Z request_id=aa71e2b KMS POST /kms/encrypt 503 
2026-03-18T02:13:12Z request_id=aa71e2b retry=1 client_error=timeout
2026-03-18T02:14:01Z request_id=bb12f9 KMS POST /kms/decrypt 503
```
They also saw spike in token-generation latency around the same windows.

Devon - SRE: I looked at infra traces: the 503s align with TLS handshake failures to kms-ap-south-1 endpoint and a downstream proxy returning 502/503 during short maintenance windows. The eu-west latency bump correlates with KV cache miss ratio spiking after their nightly batch job. Pod CPU/mem looks fine; it's tail-latency from cache churn.

Sam - Reliability Eng: Confirming Devon's correlation. Cache miss % jumped from ~4% to ~32% during the midnight job, which multiplied token generation calls and produced retry storms hitting KMS. Options: increase KV cache TTL for this customer, throttle batch job concurrency, or enable stronger client-side backoff. Increasing TTL to 8h should cut misses but raises memory; trade-offs noted.

Devon - SRE: Plan: I'll roll a conservative canary to Galen's staging shard to increase KV TTL from 30m -> 8h at 09:30 UTC today, observe 2h, then promote to prod by ~13:00 UTC if stable. If KMS 5xxs persist, Plan B is to enable envelope fallback on their agent (local envelope + periodic KMS wrapping) to avoid synchronous KMS path for nightly jobs.

Liam - Solutions Eng: For renewal negotiation: recommend proposing a Reserved pool + committed capacity to cap unit cost and provide guaranteed throughput in eu-west/ap-south. Also offer a short enablement session on KMS best practices and retry/backoff tuning. @Aisha can you surface the cost model and a proposed committed offer?

Aisha - CSM: Yes — I'll assemble a cost model PDF and FTE impact notes and schedule a call with Galen's engineering and procurement for next Tue. Also capturing an enablement ask: they want a 30-40 minute runbook walkthrough (KMS fallback, cache sizing, and emergency rollback steps). I'll draft the runbook and attach to ticket.

Ruth - Galen Labs (customer): Appreciate the quick triage. Nightly ingest jobs are critical — any ETA for the fix? Also would like the runbook before the call so our infra team can review.

Devon - SRE: Timeline: canary at 09:30 UTC, monitor metrics for 2h (p95 latency, cache miss rate, KMS 5xx count). If canary looks good, full rollout by 13:00 UTC. If KMS errors continue after rollout, we'll enable local envelope fallback at 14:00 UTC as temporary mitigation. I'll post metric snapshots here during the window.

kms-bot: Alert: kms-ap-south-1 returned 503 x18 in last 60m; aggregated error rate 0.9% for Galen Labs service. Ticket CS-5421 created and linked.

Aisha - CSM: Added ticket CS-5421 to Zendesk, linked renewal notes and runbook draft placeholder. I'll update customer after canary and include cost model in the prep pack. I'll also schedule the enablement session — aiming for next Wed so they can review runbook before procurement call.

Liam - Solutions Eng: I'll prepare the short playbook slides (3 slides) on retry/backoff + envelope fallback and drop them in the ticket.

Devon - SRE: Canary roll scheduled. I'll report back with the metric diffs and any unexpected errors.

Aisha - CSM: Thanks all — please react in-thread with :thumbsup: if you're aligned or flag concerns. I'll ping again once canary completes.
